title: Satyaveer Singh v. Executive Engineer, Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Ashok Bhushan, J.; Virendra Singh, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner relegated to Supply Code 2005
headnote: A writ seeking mandamus to survey and physically verify whether installations of a billed tube-well connection exist is not the appropriate proceeding; the consumer is left to remedies under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Satyaveer Singh sought a mandamus directing Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. to survey and physically verify his tube-well site and surrounding locality to ascertain whether electric poles, insulators, a transformer and other installations relating to connection no. 53/775 in his name existed. The licensee stated that the connection had been energised on 1 February 1997 and that dues and recovery had been initiated. The petitioner maintained that the connection itself was not in existence and required physical verification.

holding_units.topic: writ forum; relegated to Supply Code
holding_units.holding: Writ proceedings are not the appropriate forum for a direction to survey and physically verify the existence of installations relating to a billed electricity connection. The petitioner may seek relief under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The writ petition was dismissed.

not_decided.point: existence of connection no. 53/775 and related installations
not_decided.note: Physical verification of the tube-well site, and the dues and recovery, were left to Supply Code remedies.
